soundness_flags.label: ass:stable-noninfecting-history-response
soundness_flags.one_line: The no-priming restriction is load-bearing yet serial serology and negative tests do not establish that an unrecorded noninfecting exposure leaves all later controlled responses unchanged; the short-window assertion alone does not show a realistic regime in which it holds.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:reference-risk-positivity / thm:sharp-reciprocal-endpoints
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Finite reciprocal endpoints are conditional on fiber-wide period-two vaccine reference-risk positivity, rather than following from trial-cell positivity.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The Charnes--Cooper endpoint theorem is sharp only conditional on ass:reference-risk-positivity; the unconditional claim is the extended identified-set theorem.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 point-identifies the first-interval challenge effect and gives sharp second-interval bounds; Assumption 6 is no waning of placebo and yields bounds for an early-to-late vaccine challenge-risk ratio.
The paper studies multi-variant temporal behavior: all listed measures are time-varying for all-or-none vaccines, while for leaky vaccines all but incidence-rate-ratio measures are time-varying.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Table 1 CSE_k row; time-to-event identification material
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published CSE_k is a ratio of two controlled-exposure arm risk ratios and is identified by an observed at-risk cause-specific hazard-ratio expression under additional time-to-event assumptions.
The method uses surveillance strain proportions and requires them to reflect the infecting-strain distribution for the actual or counterfactual placebo group.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid random sets for an identified set and known images of it, including uniform-in-P conditions.
The paper gives bootstrap calibrated projection confidence intervals for smooth functions of moment-(in)equality identified parameters with uniform asymptotic coverage.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the no-priming assertion with a scientifically defensible design-restricted condition, or introduce explicit post-noninfecting-exposure response coordinates and a sensitivity parameter; demonstrate how serial measurements bound that parameter.
State a formal inclusion/non-inclusion comparison between the external-margin fiber and the Perényi--Stensrud time-to-event model, with an explicit law satisfying one model but not the other.

Promote one non-routine frontier result—preferably the case-margin invariance iff or fixed-fiber radius—to a proved sharp theorem with an explicit nondegenerate separating family; retain the LP-duality and endpoint algebra as implementation corollaries.

recommended_next_step: Revise the load-bearing stable-noninfecting-history-response assumption into a credibly applicable or sensitivity-robust regime, then advance the sharp external-margin kernel as a field-tier partial-identification proposal.
